verdict.rationale: The evidence covers adjacent run-level capabilities. Snapshots capture workflow state, and time travel re-executes a workflow from any step using stored snapshot data, which gives a limited form of rolling back execution. Studio and observability let users inspect and review runs. Nothing documents versioning automation definitions or rolling back to a prior version of a workflow. Missing for 10: versioning of workflow and agent definitions, a diff or review flow for changes to automations, rollback to a previous automation version, and independent corroboration.
